card.name: Small words before place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, in, of, from and and, right before a place name that comes next, such as Turks, Muscat, Arusha, Cooktown, Mecca or Baghdad. Seen in general web text about geography and history, especially Middle East and East Africa.

modes.label: Preposition before a city
modes.description: In, of or from after a place or institution, just before a city name.
modes.example: The embassy<< in>> Muscat was established Jul 4,

modes.label: Distance phrases
modes.description: Of or from after a distance or direction, before a town name.
modes.example: Loliondo Game Controlled Area in Ngorongoro district of Arusha region, 400 km northwest<< of>> Arusha.

modes.label: The before a people or state
modes.description: The or and just before a nationality or country name.
modes.example: leading the Arab Revolt against<< the>> Turks during the First World War.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting a proper name, and away from words beginning with Q.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "in" or "of" when a place name such as Arusha or Muscat is about to follow.
